!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
  <title>SP Fitness World</title>
  <meta name="description" content="SP Fitness World — Modern gym with trainers, classes, gallery and sunset motivation." />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@300;500;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root{--primary:#6fb7ea;--dark:#08121a;--muted:#6b7280;--glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);--accent:#0b72a7;font-family: 'Montserrat', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial;}
    *{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{height:100%;margin:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f7fbff 0%, #ffffff 100%);color:var(--dark);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
    .nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 24px;background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.95), rgba(255,255,255,0.8));backdrop-filter:blur(6px);z-index:40;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(2,6,23,0.04)}
    .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.brand img{height:52px;width:52px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:10px}.brand h1{font-size:18px;margin:0}
    .nav-links{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}.nav-links a{color:var(--dark);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}.cta{padding:8px 14px;background:var(--primary);color:#fff;border-radius:10px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700}
    .hero{min-height:78vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 460px;gap:28px;padding:110px 6% 40px;align-items:center}
    .hero-left{max-width:720px}.eyebrow{display:inline-block;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--primary),var(--accent));color:white;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px}
    h2{font-size:40px;margin:0 0 14px;line-height:1.06}p.lead{color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;margin:0 0 18px}
    .hero-cta{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:14px}
    .btn{padding:11px 16px;border-radius:10px;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}
    .btn-primary{background:var(--primary);color:white}
    .btn-outline{background:transparent;border:2px solid var(--primary);color:var(--primary)}
    .hero-right{position:relative;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(11,21,30,0.08)}.hero-right img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
    section{padding:70px 6%}.container{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto}
    .about{display:flex;gap:24px;align-items:center}.about img{width:48%;border-radius:12px}.about .txt{flex:1}
    .services{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:16px}.service{background:white;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(11,21,30,0.04)}
    .gallery-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}.gallery-grid img{width:100%;height:220px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px}
    .sunset{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:340px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:18px}.sunset .bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-position:center;background-size:cover;transform:translateZ(0);will-change:transform}.sunset .overlay{position:relative;padding:24px;text-align:center;color:white;z-index:2}.sunset:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.22), rgba(0,0,0,0.45));z-index:1}
    .contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 360px;gap:20px}form{background:white;padding:16px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(11,21,30,0.06)}form input, form textarea{width:100%;padding:10px;margin:8px 0;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #e6eef7}
    footer{padding:24px 6%;background:#f5f8fb;color:var(--muted)}
    .modal{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(2,6,23,0.45);z-index:60;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:all .2s}.modal.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}.modal-card{background:white;padding:20px;border-radius:12px;width:360px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(2,6,23,0.35)}
    /* quotes */
    .quotes{margin-top:18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,21,30,0.02), rgba(11,21,30,0.02));padding:22px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .quote-card{max-width:920px;text-align:center;padding:18px 26px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.7), rgba(255,255,255,0.55));box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(11,21,30,0.06)}
    .quote-text{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--dark);line-height:1.3;opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:all .6s ease}
    .quote-text.show{opacity:1;transform:none;text-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(111,183,234,0.12)}
    .quote-author{margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
    /* motivation badge */
    .badge{display:inline-flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--primary),var(--accent));color:white;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(11,21,30,0.08)}
    .badge small{font-weight:600;opacity:0.95}
    /* reveal */
    .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:all .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1)}.reveal.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
    @media (max-width:1000px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr; padding-top:100px}.hero-right{height:360px}.gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
    @media (max-width:600px){.brand img{height:44px;width:44px}h2{font-size:26px}.hero-right{height:240px}.gallery-grid img{height:140px}}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <nav class="nav">
    <div class="brand">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64,
